findings.claim: Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false); lineage_support records terminal metadata at terminal_score_time 0.99 / terminal_state_time 1.0 with one future_resampling_node per batch, so descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity. No final-affinity benefit comparison can be reported.

Survival enrichment is weak and mostly null: landmark_00_soft_mass (survival_effects:0, effect_z 0.365, q 0.120), landmark_07_soft_mass (survival_effects:70, 0.220, q 0.356), landmark_10_soft_mass (survival_effects:100, 0.234, q 0.302), landmark_18_local_czz (survival_effects:186, 0.217, q 0.302), landmark_02_local_dz (survival_effects:23, 0.206, q 0.356), landmark_04_local_czz (survival_effects:46, 0.266, q 0.302). All are BH-adjusted non-significant; none is a decoded terminal affinity effect.

Endpoint point-estimate ranking is dominated by pair kernels: pair_kernel_1.5 (endpoint_effects:9, integrated z 0.562, q 1.46e-4), pair_kernel_2.5 (endpoint_effects:10, 0.631, q 2.19e-5), pair_kernel_3.5 (endpoint_effects:11, 0.540, q 9.75e-5), pair_kernel_5.0 (endpoint_effects:12, 0.319, q 3.71e-3), with pair_kernel_7.0 negative (endpoint_effects:13, -0.485, q 1.46e-4) and landmark_00_occupancy3 positive (endpoint_effects:15, 0.545, q 2.35e-4) versus landmark_00_softmin negative (endpoint_effects:14, -0.481, q 8.13e-4).

Branch-adjusted covariance and correlation agree on the short pair kernels: pair_kernel_1.5 (branch_adjusted:86, q 0.081; branch_adjusted:240, q 0.019) and pair_kernel_2.5 (branch_adjusted:87, q 0.077; branch_adjusted:241, q 0.046), with same-sign batch fractions 0.79 and 0.93. Joint innovation and internal RMS are negative and reproducible (branch_adjusted:228, q 9.3e-5, 1.0 same-sign; branch_adjusted:230, q 1.5e-4, 1.0; branch_adjusted:305, q 2.8e-4, 0.93; branch_adjusted:307, q 9.7e-4, 1.0).

Shape_yy is the one shape coordinate with a consistent negative association across raw and adjusted views (branch_adjusted:158, q 4.2e-5, 1.0 same-sign; branch_adjusted:235, q 2.9e-4, 1.0), while shape_yz is weaker (branch_adjusted:81, q 0.131; branch_adjusted:85, q 0.255). Joint translation and internal RMS are negative in both raw and adjusted covariance (branch_adjusted:75/76 and branch_adjusted:152/153).

Continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear fits over support [0.0,0.49] with extrapolation_allowed=false and polynomial_accepted=false; landmark_00 and landmark_01 features show many sign changes (e.g., continuous:1 sign_changes 6, strong_sign_conflicts 9; continuous:7 sign_changes 9, strong_sign_conflicts 14; continuous:17 sign_changes 7, strong_sign_conflicts 18) and relative_node_RMSE up to 0.995, so a constant rule is not supported and a time-conditioned rule would need validated fits rather than arbitrary bins.

curve_support reports only 24 of the candidate curves pass the fidelity rule (relative_rmse_le 0.35, strong_sign_conflict_nodes_eq 0, quiet_node_large_fit_fraction_le 0.1), and the listed audit entries show last_fit_z disagreeing in sign with last_empirical_z for many features (e.g., landmark_00_softmin last_empirical_z -0.146 vs last_fit_z -0.481; landmark_02_softmin -0.188 vs 0.253; landmark_06_softmin -0.402 vs 0.294). Curve fits are not absolute reward targets.

Turnover accounting separates population, edge and residual rates: population rates are mostly non-significant (e.g., turnover:0 q 0.826; turnover:39 q 0.012 is an exception), while edge rates and turnover_residual_rate are large and significant for many local_cxx/local_cyy features (turnover:14 q 0.038, turnover:17 q 0.033, turnover:47 q 0.014, turnover:134 q 0.012, turnover:224 q 0.012, turnover:227 q 0.019, turnover:254 q 0.012, turnover:257 q 0.055, turnover:497 q 0.012, turnover:524 q 0.012, turnover:584 q 0.012, turnover:587 q 0.031). The residual is an accounting diagnostic including reclassification and parent weighting, not a causal selection effect.

Parent-child increment contrasts are mostly non-significant after BH: landmark_00_softmin (increment_effects:14, q 0.046, success_failure_integrated_rate_z -4.91) and landmark_00_occupancy3 (increment_effects:15, q 0.081, +4.28) are the strongest, with shape_xx (increment_effects:3, q 0.095, -3.70), shape_yy (increment_effects:4, q 0.161, -3.85), pair_kernel_2.5 (increment_effects:10, q 0.208, +3.96), pair_kernel_7.0 (increment_effects:13, q 0.208, -3.14), landmark_03_occupancy5 (increment_effects:25, q 0.161, -3.02) and landmark_01_occupancy5 (increment_effects:19, q 0.227, -2.56).

Joint diagnostics show selection innovation is positively associated with innovation_native_alignment (joint_diagnostics:1, q 2.2e-9, 1.0 positive batch fraction) and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment (joint_diagnostics:11, q 2.2e-9, 1.0), but negatively associated with observed_child_score_gain (joint_diagnostics:2, q 1.8e-7, 0.0 positive batch fraction). Teacher contrast is dominated by internal fraction (joint_diagnostics:14, 0.787) over translation (joint_diagnostics:12, 0.132) and rotation (joint_diagnostics:13, 0.081).

information_audit reports compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A mean 0.081 (CI 0.070-0.092) and compressed_chosen_teacher_score_correlation mean 0.102 (CI 0.065-0.140), with top4_teacher_overlap 0.470; teacher_modes lists 28 teachers with assignment_rms_A quantiles [0.446, 0.863, 1.050] and temperature_edits=false. These are observational geometric diagnostics, not causal affinity effects.

Regional enrichment_z is positive for soft_mass at several landmarks (regional_effects:0 q 1.9e-4; regional_effects:100 q 3.7e-4; regional_effects:70 q 7.4e-3) and for local_dy at landmarks 02, 06, 09, 14, 18 (regional_effects:22 q 1.3e-4; regional_effects:62 q 5.7e-7; regional_effects:92 q 1.2e-5; regional_effects:142 q 3.4e-6; regional_effects:182 q 9.2e-6), while local_cyy is consistently negative (regional_effects:5 q 1.3e-4; regional_effects:15 q 1.3e-4; regional_effects:75 q 7.1e-5; regional_effects:165 q 1.3e-4; regional_effects:195 q 4.7e-4). Parent-edge contrast rates are large for local_cxx/local_cyy (regional_effects:404 q 0.029; regional_effects:405 q 0.036; regional_effects:474 q 0.004; regional_effects:475 q 0.030; regional_effects:594 q 0.004; regional_effects:595 q 0.030).

hypotheses.claim: Short pair-distance shell density (pair_kernel_1.5-3.5) is the most reproducible coordinate hypothesis: positive in endpoint, branch-adjusted covariance and adjusted correlation with high same-sign batch fractions, while pair_kernel_7.0 is negative. A testable intervention would target the 1.5-3.5 A pair shell; the discriminating failure condition is a sign reversal or loss of batch agreement in the short-kernel contrast under the endpoint-VJP reward.

Shape_yy and joint internal/innovation RMS are consistently negative across raw and adjusted views with high same-sign batch fractions, suggesting a within-path change rather than cohort composition; the discriminating failure condition is a positive adjusted shape_yy or joint_internal_RMS_A contrast in an independent batch set.

Most continuous contrast curves have many sign changes and poor fit fidelity, so a time-conditioned rule is only defensible for the 24 curves passing the curve_support fidelity rule; the discriminating failure condition is a validated fit that reverses sign within the observed support.

Large edge and turnover_residual rates for local_cxx/local_cyy indicate changing cohort composition and reclassification rather than a clean within-path change; the discriminating failure condition is a population rate that matches the residual rate, which would support within-path change instead.

Selection innovation aligns with teacher contrast and native alignment but anti-aligns with observed child score gain, so a teacher-contrast-based coordinate rule may not improve observed child score; the discriminating failure condition is a positive association between selection innovation and observed_child_score_gain.

Regional soft_mass and local_dy enrichment is positive at several landmarks while local_cyy is consistently negative, suggesting a region-specific coordinate hypothesis; the discriminating failure condition is a sign reversal of the local_cyy enrichment in an independent batch set.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity; decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures.
All weak and null scalar effects retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters; no temperature edit is proposed.
